task_instance: Create a .NET console app that uses the Azure.ResourceManager.WeightsAndBiases SDK to build and submit a 'create Weights & Biases instance' request (the skill's core documented workflow: install the package, authenticate with DefaultAzureCredential, construct a WeightsAndBiasesInstanceData payload with Marketplace/User/PartnerProperties, and call instances.CreateOrUpdateAsync).
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable is provisioning a real Azure Weights & Biases Marketplace resource via Azure Resource Manager. This requires an authenticated Azure identity (DefaultAzureCredential succeeding via env vars, managed identity, Azure CLI login, etc.) plus a real Azure subscription/resource group and an active Azure Marketplace agreement for the wandb offer. None of that is available or permitted in this sandbox (no credentials/tokens allowed, no account-bound/paid services). Running the program produced the expected CredentialUnavailableException from DefaultAzureCredential, confirming this is exactly where the task requires credentials the sandbox cannot supply. Everything achievable without Azure credentials (package install, code authoring, compiling against the real published SDK, and exercising the request-building code path) was completed and verified. Note: the skill doc's C# samples use object-initializer syntax for WeightsAndBiasesOfferDetails/MarketplaceDetails/PartnerProperties/InstanceProperties that does not compile against the actual published SDK v1.0.0 (these types have required positional constructor parameters); had to adapt the code to the real API shape to get a successful build.
